newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Andalusia auctions 10.8 bln pta in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Andalusia auctions 10.8 bln pta in bonds.

text.p: Spain's Andalusian regional government (Junta de Andalucia) allotted on Thursday in a public auction a total of 10.8 billion pesetas in three- five- and 10-year bonds, the regional government said.
The allocation took place with a slight reduction in yields compared with the previous auction in October.
ISSUE Yield Pvs Price Pvs Bid Allocated
NOTE - * On the five-year maturity Andalusia offered a new bond, others are new tranches of old issues.
Moody's long term debt rating for Junta de Andalucia is Aa3. At the end of June 1996 the region's total debt was 732 billion pesetas of which 236 billion pesetas is in bonds.
